phoenix.//: The Sign In card: the provider's own sign-in page for an OAuth sign-in (org.webosphoenix.service.oauth authorize), launched by the OAuth service with {session}; its page asks the service for the address and goes there. The shell draws its bar (host, lock, Cancel). Never launched by itself; not in the launcher. trustLevel default, not trusted: the provider's page loads in this card, and WebAppMgr lets a trusted app's page load local files (wam src/platform/webengine/web_page_blink.cc:139-143). Its one group, oauth.card, asks for the pending sign-in's address and nothing else. docs/SYNERGY-CONNECTORS.md 4.1.
